title: Debounce with cancel and flush
prompt: Implement debounce(fn, wait, timers) in debounce.js. timers is an object with setTimeout and clearTimeout (default: the global ones). The returned function, when called, schedules fn to run wait ms after the latest call, with that latest call's arguments and this. It also has: cancel(), which drops a pending call; flush(), which runs a pending call at once and returns fn's result (or undefined when nothing is pending); and pending(), true while a call is scheduled. Do not change test.js.
